scope: Corollary 7.2 of the manuscript “Relative denominators and effective systems for log Calabi-Yau fibrations” (preprints/Relative-denominators-and-effective-systems-for-log-Calabi-Yau-fibrations-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a539053eb28e6c4d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a finite rational coefficient set Φ ⊂ [0, 1] ∩ Q. There is a positive integer r = r(Φ) such that the following holds. Let (X, B) be a projective klt fourfold pair with effective boundary having coefficients in Φ, and suppose that KX + B ∼Q 0. If there is a contraction f : X → Z with dim Z > 0 and with a rationally connected smooth projective resolution of Z, then r(KX + B) is an integral principal divisor. This includes B = 0, and every positive multiple is also principal.
